About this item

FOLDING PORTABLE E-BIKE - Electric bike with a convenient folding design. When folded, it measures 39*39*28.7” and weighs only 63 pounds. The seat and handlebars can also be adjusted to suit individual preferences. With a maximum load capacity of 330 pounds, this bike is perfect for commuting, running errands, or simply enjoying a leisurely ride.
1000W POWERFUL MOTOR - Ride in style with a 1000w (PEAK 1500W)brushless motor and 7-speed system. which can reach a top speed of 28+++ mph, and the professional 7-speed system allows you to freely choose your favorite speed. Our adult electric scooter can even climb on off-road and steep rocky roads.
REMOVABLE BATTERY - Ebikes for adults are equipped with 48V/15AH larger-capacity lithium batteries and longer lifetime, covering a range of 35-50 miles per full charge. Removable battery, convenient to bring home or office to recharge."
VERSATILE RIDING MODES - Introducing our electric bike with three different working modes - bike mode, pedal assist mode, and pedal mode. Whether you want to cruise effortlessly in bike mode, get a little extra boost in pedal assist mode, or get some exercise in pedal mode, our bike has got you covered.
LOCKABLE SUSPENSION FORK - The adult electric bicycles employ a lockable front suspension fork, 5 levels LCD intelligent display and LED headlight. Both offer you a smoother and safer riding experience.
SAFE AND RELIABLE BRAKING - Feel safe and secure on your rides, even in challenging conditions, with a disc brake system for reliable and efficient braking and front and rear shock absorbers for smooth and comfortable rides.
CONQUER ANY TERRAIN WITH 20 "X 4" FAT TIRES - Equipped with 20 "x 4" puncture-proof fat tires for better performance and a cooler look, this e-bike can be ridden on any terrain - from snow-covered streets to sandy beaches, rugged mountain trails, and even the urban jungle. With these versatile tires, your riding experience is not limited to just one type of terrain, allowing you to confidently and easily explore the world around you.
ONE-YEAR WARRANTY - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a one-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. Feel free to reach out for any inquiries, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for some time.

Product Description

The H20 folding e-bike not only has excellent functions but also has a unique appearance design. Whether commuting in the city or exploring the outdoors, it allows you to be the center of attention and show off your unique charm.

Foldable Bicycle
With its easy two-step folding design, this bike can be conveniently stored in the trunk, saving space and enhancing your RV, camper, or van adventures.

Smooth Gear Shifting with Shimano 7-Speed
With Shimano 7-speed, you can easily shift into a lower gear for easier pedaling on hills or at low speed, and shift up to the highest gear for faster riding.

Comfortable and Adjustable Bike Seat
The seat is liftable and shock-absorbing, which allows you to adjust it to your height and improves overall comfort during rides, especially on rough terrain.

Removable Bike Battery
The removable battery design of the 48v15ah lithium-ion battery makes charging more convenient. It enables a motorized range of up to 20-25 miles and a pedaling and motor-assisted range of 35-50 miles.

Waterproof LCD Display
This LCD interface provides information on battery power, speed mode, and accumulated mileage in a compact format.

Powerful Braking Performance
The high-quality mechanical disc brakes provide increased safety during your ride. The front wheel quick-release design enables easier installation and convenient carrying.
